answer: An admission auction stops sybil attacks by selling a fixed number of identity slots each epoch, like terraces on a hillside: only so many fit at each level. Agents bid POA for a slot, and a beacon posts each winning bid. Creating 1000 fake identities means paying 5 POA per slot, or 5000 POA locked up, while an honest agent pays 5 POA once. A grove of honest agents shares watching the beacon, so fake slots are spotted and are not worth buying.
